server/openmausbot.ts.name: Server entry
server/openmausbot.ts.description: Runs the CLI main() and exits after flushing, closing quietly on a broken pipe.

server/cli.ts.name: CLI and launcher
server/cli.ts.description: Parses setup, serve, pair and service commands and restarts the server under the crash and restart-exit policy.

server/index.ts.name: Server composition root
server/index.ts.description: Wires stores, runtime, bus, routes, SSE, timers and shutdown, and listens on loopback plus an optional tunnel socket.

server/schema.ts.name: JSON parse helpers
server/schema.ts.description: Parses JSON with BOM tolerance and formats the first zod issue as a short message.

server/store.ts.name: Bot and room store
server/store.ts.description: Holds bots, rooms and threads in memory and saves them through registry commits with a chosen durability.

server/registry-store.ts.name: JSON registry layout
server/registry-store.ts.description: Writes bots.json and groups.json whole with fsync and rename, skipping unchanged text, behind a row-ready interface.

server/atomic.ts.name: Atomic file writes
server/atomic.ts.description: Writes files via temp file, fsync and rename with owner-only mode and Windows rename retries.

server/save-batch.ts.name: Batched saves
server/save-batch.ts.description: Coalesces whole-file saves requested during one synchronous pass into one write when the pass ends.

server/message-db.ts.name: Messages database
server/message-db.ts.description: Opens messages.db in WAL mode and creates message, thread-state, follow-up, receipt and notification tables.

server/runtime/types.ts.name: Assignment types
server/runtime/types.ts.description: Defines the assignment record, statuses, origin, requester, assignee, modes and the TERMINAL set.

server/runtime/runtime.ts.name: Job runtime engine
server/runtime/runtime.ts.description: Runs the assignment state machine: boot reconciliation, enqueue admission, budgets, tick, waits, wakes and cancel.

server/runtime/store.ts.name: Runtime SQLite store
server/runtime/store.ts.description: Persists assignments, events and inbox rows in runtime.db with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions and savepoints.

server/runtime-coordinator.ts.name: Runtime coordinator
server/runtime-coordinator.ts.description: Opens runtime.db, sets depth and budget limits, imports legacy ledgers and exposes tick, pace and prune to the host.

server/coordinator.ts.name: Coordinator interface
server/coordinator.ts.description: Declares the coordinate_bots call shape, handoff views and the factory for the runtime coordinator.

server/admission.ts.name: Admission rules
server/admission.ts.description: Decides start, queue, steer or refuse per surface from supplied state, with no IO.

server/handoff-ticks.ts.name: Runtime tick clock
server/handoff-ticks.ts.description: Schedules runtime ticks at 250 ms when busy, 10 s when parked and hourly when idle, with kick().

server/harness/bus.ts.name: Event bus
server/harness/bus.ts.description: Fans adapter events to listeners and appends redacted batches to per-thread NDJSON logs with overflow warnings.

server/harness/http.ts.name: HTTP helpers
server/harness/http.ts.description: Provides json replies with response hooks, body reading with limits and parsed-body checks.

server/harness/registry.ts.name: Provider registry
server/harness/registry.ts.description: Builds and tracks provider driver instances, their probes, status and installs for the server.

server/contracts.ts.name: Provider contracts
server/contracts.ts.description: Defines ProviderAdapter, its capability flags, runtime events and turn input types shared by drivers.

server/live-turns.ts.name: Live turn tracker
server/live-turns.ts.description: Tracks the running turn id per thread from turn.started and turn.completed events.

server/agents-turn.ts.name: Agents turn env
server/agents-turn.ts.description: Derives the per-turn agents MCP environment from conversation facts so tool lists stay stable for caching.

server/internal-turns.ts.name: Internal turn marks
server/internal-turns.ts.description: Marks threads whose running turn was started by the harness rather than a person's message.

server/harness-capabilities.ts.name: Harness capability lines
server/harness-capabilities.ts.description: Describes tools gained or lost when a thread moves between drivers with and without the agents MCP.

server/harness-mcp-token.ts.name: MCP token env names
server/harness-mcp-token.ts.description: Names the per-family environment variable that carries each harness MCP bearer token.

server/drivers/agents-bridge.ts.name: Tool bridge
server/drivers/agents-bridge.ts.description: Lists a few tools plus find_tool and use_tool so hidden tools run under the same judgment as direct calls.

server/turn-watchdog.ts.name: Turn watchdog
server/turn-watchdog.ts.description: Stops turns silent past stall limits, sparing parked turns and shell commands still using CPU.

server/restart.ts.name: Restart policy
server/restart.ts.description: Defines restart and crash exit codes, backoff table and the rule that decides whether a launcher starts again.

server/crash-guard.ts.name: Crash guard
server/crash-guard.ts.description: Attributes uncaught errors to the owning turn, survives socket errors and exits with the crash code otherwise.

server/graceful-shutdown.ts.name: Graceful shutdown
server/graceful-shutdown.ts.description: Runs cleanup jobs concurrently under an eight-second deadline then calls the exit function.

server/data-dir-lease.ts.name: Data dir lease
server/data-dir-lease.ts.description: Re-exports the shared lease protocol and a release-once helper used on every exit path.

electron/data-dir-lease.mjs.name: Lease protocol
electron/data-dir-lease.mjs.description: Implements the data-directory lease file with atomic link, boot id and machine id checks shared by Electron and server.

server/engine-stop.ts.name: Engine stop
server/engine-stop.ts.description: Ends an engine by closing stdin, then SIGTERM, then killing its remaining process tree within fixed grace times.

server/engine-memory.ts.name: Engine memory gate
server/engine-memory.ts.description: Makes turns that need a new engine wait for memory and process room on Linux servers.

server/machine-pressure.ts.name: Machine pressure
server/machine-pressure.ts.description: Reads memory, CPU, steal and event-loop signals to say whether deferrable work should wait.

server/routines.ts.name: Routine manager
server/routines.ts.description: Stores routines and runs, ticks the scheduler, starts due runs and tracks run progress and recovery.

server/routine-due.ts.name: Routine due times
server/routine-due.ts.description: Computes when routines next need the machine for desktop wake holds and Cloud sleep checks.

server/routine-catch-up.ts.name: Routine catch-up
server/routine-catch-up.ts.description: Runs the newest missed occurrence late within twelve hours and collapses older ones into a counted missed row.

server/routine-recovery.ts.name: Routine failure recovery
server/routine-recovery.ts.description: Maps run failures to retry, wait for limit reset or immediate failure with owner-facing causes.

server/routine-ledger.ts.name: Occurrence ledger
server/routine-ledger.ts.description: Appends one JSONL record per scheduled occurrence with state, reason, attempts and a machine lease.

server/routine-restarts.ts.name: Routine restart pacing
server/routine-restarts.ts.description: Throttles startup routines on headless servers and staggers reruns of runs a restart cut off.

server/routine-run-limits.ts.name: Routine run limits
server/routine-run-limits.ts.description: Reads environment hours for default routine and goal run limits, bounded to 24 hours.

server/host/check-backs.ts.name: Bot check-backs
server/host/check-backs.ts.description: Persists times a bot chose to return to a chat and starts each at most once, late if missed.

server/host/person-waits.ts.name: Person waits
server/host/person-waits.ts.description: Derives when a conversation rests on an open card and notifies the person.

server/host/proactive.ts.name: Proactive wiring
server/host/proactive.ts.description: Wires routine checks, the read-and-draft fence, the brief and the default watch routine.

server/waits.ts.name: Bot waits
server/waits.ts.description: Stores wait_until conditions on time, URL text, file change or process and probes them on a tick.

server/due-timer.ts.name: Due timer
server/due-timer.ts.description: Runs a callback when the earliest due time arrives, re-checking the wall clock to survive machine sleep.

server/webhooks.ts.name: Webhook triggers
server/webhooks.ts.description: Stores webhook triggers with sealed secrets and delivery receipts and builds provenance-labelled run input.

server/webhook-ingress.ts.name: Webhook ingress
server/webhook-ingress.ts.description: Serves the webhook receiver on its own port or Unix socket with a 256 KB body limit.

server/bot-link/protocol.ts.name: Bot link protocol
server/bot-link/protocol.ts.description: Defines linked bot addresses and frames exchanged between a computer and its Cloud.

server/bot-link/link.ts.name: Bot link
server/bot-link/link.ts.description: Carries hand-offs and results between a person's computer and Cloud, acting once per assignment id.

server/usage-ledger.ts.name: Usage ledger
server/usage-ledger.ts.description: Appends per-turn usage rows with tokens, model, trigger and price under the data dir, never storing message text.

server/usage-caps.ts.name: Usage caps
server/usage-caps.ts.description: Totals day and month spend by server and bot and reports which USD or token caps are reached.

server/decision-log.ts.name: Decision log
server/decision-log.ts.description: Appends redacted monthly NDJSON rows recording why tool calls were allowed, denied or carded.

server/usage-trace/recorder.ts.name: Turn trace recorder
server/usage-trace/recorder.ts.description: Builds step and tool spans from runtime events and hands timing and outcome to the usage row.

server/usage-trace/spans.ts.name: Trace spans
server/usage-trace/spans.ts.description: Appends batched daily span lines with names, times and token counts and never arguments or outputs.

server/sessions.ts.name: Sessions and pairing
server/sessions.ts.description: Issues single-use pairing codes, hashed-token sessions and stream tickets and persists them atomically.

server/request-auth.ts.name: Request auth
server/request-auth.ts.description: Authorizes loopback and session requests with owner or service trust, scopes and same-origin checks.

server/enterprise.ts.name: Enterprise hook
server/enterprise.ts.description: Loads the optional enterprise layer if present and reports the edition and license status.

relay/src/main.ts.name: Relay entry
relay/src/main.ts.description: Loads config, starts the relay and drains it on shutdown with a deadline.

relay/src/server.ts.name: Relay server
relay/src/server.ts.description: Routes host, data and phone WebSockets to handlers with connection caps and per-IP limits.

relay/src/hosts.ts.name: Relay hosts
relay/src/hosts.ts.description: Tracks each host's control socket, admitted phones and sessions and verifies host tokens.

relay/src/splice.ts.name: Relay splice
relay/src/splice.ts.description: Joins phone and host data sockets with backpressure, throttling and heavy-session metering.

relay/src/limits.ts.name: Relay limits
relay/src/limits.ts.description: Derives client keys from a trusted proxy header and provides IP and token-bucket limiters.

cloudflare/control-plane/src/index.ts.name: Control plane routes
cloudflare/control-plane/src/index.ts.description: Routes account, installation, tunnel, relay token and push requests in the Cloudflare Worker.

connector/src/adopted-home.ts.name: Adopted home
connector/src/adopted-home.ts.description: Attaches to a customer-run Docker Compose home to start, stop, back up and update it.

electron/boot.mjs.name: Desktop boot
electron/boot.mjs.description: Enables Node's compile cache then imports the Electron main module.
